Headline: 952,730 Promoter Shares of Bank of Kathmandu in Auction from Today
Full Content:
The existing promoter of
Bank of Kathmandu Limited (BOKL)
is auctioning 9,52,730 units of shares to promoter shareholders from today i.e 19th Poush, 2079
9,52,730 units of promoter shares of BOKL will be auctioned at a par value of Rs. 200 per share. Only existing promoters are eligible to bid for the auction within 35 days from the date of publication of this notice, i.e. 19th Poush. The shareholders should submit their bids at the central office of the bank.
If no bids are received from the existing founder shareholders within the mentioned date, then the shares will be later auctioned to the general public.
BOKL and Global IME Bank inked a merger agreement with each other on 2nd Ashad with a swap ratio of 1:1.

Headline: Two Auction Concluding Today: Premier Insurance Company's auction of CIT's promoter shares and BOKL's auction of its own promoter shares
Full Content:
Premier Insurance Company (Nepal) Limited's re-auctioning of its 50,000 units promoter shares of Citizen Investment Trust is concluding today, i.e. 4th Ashwin, 2077.
Only banks, financial institutions, and insurance companies were eligible to bid for the auction.
Bidders who are selected are entitled to claim the right shares of Citizen Investment Trust approved by the General Meeting on Ashad 20.
Similarly, Bank of Kathmandu's auction of its 3,16,156 units promoter share to the existing promoters, general public, and institutions is also concluding today at 2 pm. The bids of this particular auction will be opened tomorrow at 10:30 am.

Headline: Bank of Kathmandu postpones auction amidst lockdown
Full Content:
Bank of Kathmandu has postponed its 3,16,156 unit promoter shares auction due to ongoing lockdown.
The previous deadline was Bhadra 08, 2 pm. However, since Kathmandu was in lockdown from Bhadra 03 to Bhadra, 10, the deadline for the auction was extended till today, i.e. Bhadra 15.
However, since the lockdown is still effective, the auction is postponed until further notice.
Bank of Kathmandu Limited (BOKL) had auctioned its 3,16,156 units promoter share to the existing promoters, general public, and institutions from Bhadra 1. The minimum bid rate is set at Rs 140. Similarly, the minimum bid quantity is 1000 units while there is no maximum quantity limit for application, meaning that the general public can apply for the entire 3,16,156 units. However, individual investors are required to abide by Nepal Rastra Bank's rule to not exceed the specified quantity of shares per entity.

Headline: BOKL Auctioning 3,16,156 promoter shares to the existing promoter and general public; Minimum bid rate set at Rs. 140
Full Content:
Bank of Kathmandu Limited (BOKL) is auctioning its 3,16,156 units promoter share to the existing promoters, general public, and institutions from Bhadra 1 to Bhadra 8, 2077.
The minimum bid rate is set at Rs 140. Therefore, all the bids must be placed at Rs 140 or above.
Similarly, the minimum bid quantity is 1000 units while there is no maximum quantity limit for application, meaning that the general public can apply for the entire 3,16,156 units. However, individual investors are required to abide by Nepal Rastra Bank's rule to not exceed the specified quantity of shares per entity.
The general public can bid by filling a sealed bid form after paying Rs. 100 via NMB Capital, Nagpokhari, Naxal.

Headline: Promoter share auction of Bank of Kathmandu goes under-subscribed; Cutoff at Rs 160.25 with highest bid at Rs 202
Full Content:
Bank of Kathmandu (BOKL)
was auctioning 3.70 lakh unit promoter shares from Magh 15 to Magh 22 of 2076. The auctioned shares belonged to Shakti Kumar Golyan. Since none of the existing promoters applied to buy the shares, it is now being offered to the general public.
NMB Capital is the issue manager of the auction.
According to the issue manager, the auction went undersubscribed. The minimum bid price was fixed at Rs 160 and the lowest bid/cutoff stood at Rs 160.25. A total of 8 applications were received but 2 got disqualified. The remaining 6 applicants applied for and were allotted 64,200 units. The maximum bid was received at Rs 202.
The bank will re-auction the remaining shares soon. Similarly, the disqualified applicants will receive their funds back from Falgun 01, 2076 (Today).

Headline: Almost 2 crore units bonus, right & promoter shares of Bank of Kathmandu & 5 other companies listed in NEPSE for trading
Full Content:
Nepal Stock Exchange Limited (NEPSE) has listed 1.36 crore unit bonus/right shares of 5 different companies and 61.58 lakh unit promoter shares of Bank of Kathmandu Limited. Now the investors holding bonus/right and promoter shares of these companies can sell their bonus and promoter shares.
Listing of promoter shares of Bank of Kathmandu Limited
61,58,067 units Promoter shares of Bank of Kathmandu has been listed by NEPSE for trading.
Listing of right shares of RSDC Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha
23,00,000 unit bonus shares of RSDC has been listed by NEPSE. 200% right shares was declared from the net profit of FY 2073/74.
Listing of bonus shares of ICFC Finance Limited
8,03,885 unit bonus shares of ICFC Finance Limited has been listed for trading. 10% bonus was declared previously by the finance from the net profit of FY 2073/74.
Listing of bonus shares of Soaltee Hotel Limited
86,88,244 unit bonus shares of Soaltee Hotel Limited has been listed in NEPSE. The hotel had declared 15% bonus from the net profit of FY 2073/74.
Listing of bonus shares of Swadeshi Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha Limited
1,50,000 unit bonus shares of Swadeshi Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha Limited has been listed in NEPSE. The microfinance had declared 15% bonus from the net profit of FY 2073/74.
Listing of bonus shares of Chhimek Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha
16,59,293 unit bonus shares of Chhimek Laghubitta Bittiya Sanstha has been listed for trading. 19.89% bonus was declared form the net profit of FY 2073/74.
